summary: Epics grill of the roadmap import (10 epics, 20 stories, all downstream of PAY-1 per the client's 'paydown first' directive). Coverage checked against BRIEF, goals-index, AND a merged-PR reconciliation of the five half-done goals the client named (ponytail, permission redesign, observer, observability, MCP search): ponytail Phases 1-7 in-lane + rescued WIP e4104edc8 with Phase-8 as PONY-1; observer S1 merged #264, S2/S3a rescued as branch WIP e055dc14a/a51a4909d feeding OBS-1; observability #220/#262 shipped with permission spans as OTEL-1 (not started, branch empty); MCP search #237/#255 shipped with hybrid as CAP-2 behind CAP-1; permission redesign design-only, PERM-1/2. DUR-1/MDL-1 now carry a real depends_on edge to PONY-1.
gaps: CAP-1 (capability-authoring closeout) has no committed goal-prompt, which DISCOVERY makes an import blocker for goals.
PAY-1 had no goal-prompt or story anywhere despite being the client-directed first story.
contradictions: Board says durable-work primitive and model management start post-Ponytail-cutover, but depends_on edges can only reference imported stories and the cutover is a user-gated lane, not a story.
resolutions: CAP-1 imported as an explicit closeout exception (client confirmed): finishing in-flight rescued work with a source-of-record branch and inline acceptance criteria, noted in the story text.

PAY-1 scoped in docs/architecture/architecture-debt-paydown-goal-prompt.md (committed) with the concrete five-section failing inventory; every other story depends_on PAY-1 so it is the sole initial frontier.
DUR-1 and MDL-1 import with textual ponytail-cutover gates in their story text (client confirmed); the cutover itself stays a board-tracked user-gated lane.

Exclusions confirmed by the client: media-render (validation not approved), Fable arch cycles #2-8, tenant isolation / KB ingestion / connector strategy (need design), all Parked/Ideation — each remains visible on goals-index or in the deferral ledger with its gate named. (Ponytail cutover was initially excluded; the client's reconciliation directive brought it in as PONY-1 with the explicit-user-go gate as an acceptance criterion.)

Client-directed reconciliation (2026-07-22): half-done goals audited against merged PRs; three at-risk uncommitted lanes rescued to branch commits (observer S2 e055dc14a, S3a a51a4909d, ponytail e4104edc8); PONY-1 and OTEL-1 added; goals-index stage checklists updated with citations.

Full-board validation (client-directed, same day): five goals mislabeled Parked had actually SHIPPED (#185 cross-provider context, #186 generative UI, #192 event-driven waits + async burst queue, #193 non-blocking compaction) — moved to Shipped; still parked: multi-agent-provider-onboarding (salvage lane, 6 commits) and deepagents-cache-savings (no lane). Media-render has NO lane work (board's wt-media claim corrected); ART-1 reworks a pre-protocol [HOLD] stage-1 commit; E2E-1 dispositions feature/agent-e2e-haiku-turn (+382/-11 beyond #246).
